# Greenhouse Operations Structured Brief

## Irrigation Technician
Weight: 35-45%
- checks moisture sensors
- carries handheld meter
- adjusts drip valves

## Pest Scout
Weight: 15-20%
- uses inspection cards
- logs leaf damage
- wears disposable gloves

## Propagation Bench
Humidity target: 70-80%.
If context is propagation bench: increase mist checks, force clean trays, avoid standing water.

## Shipping Bay
Low frequency but high operational risk.
If context is shipping bay: increase barcode scans and pallet checks; decrease open-water work.

Constraints:
- Do not mix sanitized propagation tools with shipping-floor carts.
- Avoid unlabeled chemical bottles.
- Must not ignore wilted starter trays.

Implementation fields:
```json
{
  "taskRole": "technician | scout | manager",
  "zone": "propagation_bench | shipping_bay | headhouse",
  "riskState": "normal | watch | urgent"
}
```

Open question: confirm whether weekend staffing changes irrigation coverage.

[1]: https://example.org/greenhouse-ops
